{{see also|:Category:Units by unit type}}

'''Unit Types''' are hidden classifications of [[enemies]], [[objects]], and [[pickups]] found in combat.
* They can be revealed in game using {{p|Study}}.
* {{a|Marked|+}} affects a unit and all other units who share one of its types.

Although some types have distinctive behavior (like the "Robots" interaction with the {{el|Electric}} [[element]]), most do not. Instead, these invisible categories get used by enemy AI logic or by abilities like {{p|Study}}.

Many shared passive effects attributed to tags are not directly given the tag, which is why certain exceptions occur, such as Skeleton-Type units that are not undead.<ref>Internal passive names: <code>Undead</code>, <code>Robot</code>, <code>Plant</code>, <code>Angel</code></ref>

Types are not exclusive, and some units possess multiple. For instance, Trash Bag is of two types: "Trash" and "Container."

== Hidden Types ==
Some types are hidden (<code>HiddenTag</code>) and don't show up when using {{p|Study}}, but will impact enemy behaviours and spread {{a|Marked|+}}.
* Most of these don't have an official name in the text files.

== Trivia ==
* Unit-Types are referred to as <code>tag</code> in the code, with <code>type</code> being used for other purposes.
